events.speaker: Maya Chen
events.title: Safety claim needs a source
events.summary: Maya attributes nearly all downtown injuries to cars without citing supporting data.
events.evidence: Almost every serious injury downtown is caused by a car.

events.speaker: Jon Bell
events.title: Access is assumed to require parking
events.summary: Jon's conclusion assumes customers cannot reach stores without parking directly outside them.
events.evidence: Remove the curb parking and those shops lose their customers.

events.speaker: Maya Chen
events.title: Delivery concern is overstated
events.summary: Maya recasts a request for delivery access as a demand to preserve every parking space.
events.evidence: Jon wants every parking space protected forever.

events.speaker: Jon Bell
events.title: Pilot position changes
events.summary: Jon now rejects any trial after earlier saying a temporary weekend pilot was reasonable.
events.evidence: I never supported trying this, even for a weekend.

events.speaker: Maya Chen
events.title: Cost question goes unanswered
events.summary: Maya responds to a question about implementation cost by returning to the safety goal.
events.evidence: The important thing is that everyone deserves to feel safe downtown.
